ns0:section.ns0:heading: Transfer of a prisoner to State authority
ns0:section.ns0:chapeau: The Director of the Bureau of Prisons shall order that a prisoner who has been charged in an indictment or information with, or convicted of, a State felony, be transferred to an official detention facility within such State prior to his release from a Federal prison facility if—

ns0:paragraph.ns0:content: the transfer has been requested by the Governor or other executive authority of the State;
the State has presented to the Director a certified copy of the indictment, information, or judgment of conviction; and
the Director finds that the transfer would be in the public interest.

ns0:section.ns0:continuation: If more than one request is presented with respect to a prisoner, the Director shall determine which request should receive preference. The expenses of such transfer shall be borne by the State requesting the transfer.

ns0:note.ns0:heading: Prior Provisions
ns0:note.ns0:p: For a prior section 3623, applicable to offenses committed prior to Nov. 1, 1987, see note set out preceding section 3601 of this title.

ns0:note.ns0:heading: Effective Date
ns0:note.ns0:p: Section effective Nov. 1, 1987, and applicable only to offenses committed after the taking effect of this section, see section 235(a)(1) of Pub. L. 98–473, set out as a note under section 3551 of this title.
